AIQIF-C9.verdict: The institution has a yearly academic audit run by the IQAC, a student satisfaction survey and a record of corrected accreditation figures. It does not yet name who keeps these records or who owns each follow-up action.
AIQIF-C9.headline: Quality is audited every year.

strengths.text: A yearly academic audit, facilitated by the IQAC.
A student satisfaction survey of the teaching-learning process, with new practices introduced from the feedback.
Changes made to accreditation figures after verification are on record, with the supporting document.

gaps.text: No person or office is named as keeper of the evidence records.
Corrective actions go to departments, but nothing records who owns each one.
Curriculum changes are reviewed as needed, with no set schedule.

AIQIF-C7.verdict: The institution has AI patents, an Incubation Centre with artificial intelligence among its focus areas, and seed funding for start-ups. It does not yet have a collaboration with a work plan for AI research.
AIQIF-C7.headline: AI patents and a funded AI start-up are on record.

strengths.text: A patent on airport security clearance with deep learning.
An Incubation Centre whose focus areas include artificial intelligence.
Seed funding for a start-up developing an AI-assisted bot for diagnosis in optometry.

gaps.text: No collaboration with an outside partner sets out AI research work.
No partner has been given responsibility for planned AI work.
No progress review records a decision about an AI project.

AIQIF-C1.verdict: The institution has a Perspective Plan and a Strategic Plan, funds earmarked for innovation and a yearly review of its IT facilities. It does not yet name an owner for its digital priorities or a route for taking AI decisions higher.
AIQIF-C1.headline: A Strategic Plan with an e-governance target is in place.

strengths.text: A Perspective Plan, with a Strategic Plan and a rolling implementation plan.
Funds earmarked by the management for innovation and entrepreneurship.
A yearly assessment of computer, IT and Wi-Fi facilities.

gaps.text: No person or office is named as owner of the e-governance priority in the plan.
No set route takes a digital or AI decision to a higher body.
The support contact for new digital services is not clearly named.

AIQIF-C8.verdict: The institution has an ERP portal, an examination process that is IT integrated, a skill partnership with ImaginXP and an Incubation Centre with AI among its focus areas. It does not yet state what any AI initiative should achieve, or how that would be measured.
AIQIF-C8.headline: ImaginXP is a skill partner for the B.Tech in AI.

strengths.text: An ERP portal, on a cloud server, through which staff and students reach their academic information.
End-semester examinations run centrally by the office of the Controller of Examinations, with the process IT integrated.
A skill partnership with ImaginXP for the B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

gaps.text: No AI initiative has a stated intended outcome.
No method is set out for measuring what an AI initiative achieves.
No service records show AI in repeated use.

AIQIF-C3.verdict: The institution has a B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, a machine learning unit in its business programme and AI in its Digital Marketing course. It does not yet set out AI-supported activities in courses, or tell students what AI use is allowed.
AIQIF-C3.headline: AI is taught in more than one programme.

strengths.text: A B.Tech programme in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, with students examined in it.
A unit on machine learning and advanced analytical techniques in Advanced Data Analysis Tools.
The role of artificial intelligence taught in the Digital Marketing course.

gaps.text: No course sets out a learning or feedback activity supported by AI.
No instructions tell students what use of AI is acceptable.
No student project or lab includes substantial AI work.

AIQIF-C4.verdict: The institution has run AI workshops for faculty through the IQAC, and a faculty member has filed a patent on AI-powered grading. It does not yet assess what faculty learn or aim AI learning at named roles.
AIQIF-C4.headline: The IQAC has run AI workshops for faculty.

strengths.text: A two-day IQAC workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Image Processing using MATLAB and Simulink.
An online workshop on industrial applications of data science and machine learning.
A faculty patent on an AI-powered auto-grading system to reduce teacher workload.

gaps.text: No assessment shows what faculty learned about AI.
No AI learning for faculty is aimed at a named role, with a practice task.
No digital training is aimed at a named non-teaching staff role.

AIQIF-C6.verdict: The institution has a campus network of servers and computers, an ERP system for its data and a firewall. It does not yet name who is responsible for its data or its security, or have a written recovery procedure.
AIQIF-C6.headline: Student, faculty and staff data are held in an ERP.

strengths.text: An IT infrastructure of servers, computers, routers and switches.
Student, faculty and non-teaching staff data digitised through the e-Varsity ERP.
A firewall that has been upgraded.

gaps.text: No person or office is named as responsible for the data in the ERP.
No one is named as responsible for security, and no written recovery procedure was found.
No lab or online environment is set up for an introductory AI course.

AIQIF-C5.verdict: The institution has a B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, a machine learning unit for business students and placements from AI-related programmes. It does not yet have assessed practical AI tasks, AI projects for students, or rules on who can take up AI internships.
AIQIF-C5.headline: Students can study AI to degree level.

strengths.text: An approved B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
A unit introducing basic and advanced machine learning algorithms for business analytics.
Graduates placed with ACT Fiber, from programmes that include AIML.

gaps.text: No practical task in the advanced AI pathway is assessed.
No AI project or portfolio opportunity is set out for students.
No rule says which students can take up AI internships.

AIQIF-C2.verdict: The institution has a Plagiarism Policy, Turnitin and DrillBit checks and a research ethics committee, but none of them covers AI yet. It does not yet have written guidance on using AI, a list of the AI tools in use, or a way to appeal an AI decision.
AIQIF-C2.headline: No written guidance on AI use was found.

strengths.text: An ERP portal on a cloud server, through which staff and students reach their own records.
A firewall that has been upgraded.

gaps.text: No guidance on how staff and students may use AI.
No list of the AI tools in use, with someone responsible for each.
No way for a person to step in, or to appeal, when an AI tool is used in a decision.
